interface.name: hyprland_hf_input_manager_v1
interface.description: This private experimental interface lets a compositor grant a focused, pointer-locked client access to an ordered relative-input observation ring. It is not a stable or proposed standard.

request.name: get_stream

description.summary: request a stream for a focused locked surface

request.description: The compositor validates the seat, surface, focus, pointer-lock state and policy. Denial is reported on the stream object.

interface.name: hyprland_hf_input_stream_v1
interface.description: Once active, immutable sample records are published by the compositor into a memfd-backed ring. The client maps it read-only. The notification fd signals overflow and revocation. Ordinary motion does not wake the client.

request.name: set_deadline_hint

description.summary: publish an advisory next consumption deadline

request.description: The timestamp uses the stream clock. The compositor may ignore or clamp this hint. A hint never grants authorization or forces spinning.

request.name: acknowledge

description.summary: acknowledge a consumed monotonic ring position

request.description: consumed_tail is the exclusive ring position consumed by the client. The compositor rejects backwards or beyond-head acknowledgements.

description.summary: stream activated and file descriptors granted
